name: mongodb-survey-stage1
description: 基于 MongoDB 的版本化问卷系统第一阶段

scripts.dev: concurrently --names logic,api,web --prefix-colors yellow,blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @survey/survey-logic" "npm run dev --workspace @survey/api" "npm run dev --workspace @survey/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @survey/survey-logic && npm run build --workspace @survey/api && npm run build --workspace @survey/web
